source.title: Blizzard World of Warcraft: Midnight Hotfixes (running list)
source.author: Blizzard Entertainment

quote: Gear obtained at levels 80-90 disenchants into Midnight materials.
notes: Official March 13, 2026 entry explicitly limits the correction to newly created Crate of Battlefield Goods. Level 10-79 gear from those crates disenchants into The War Within materials, while level 80-90 gear disenchants into Midnight materials. Do not extrapolate to all gear or assume exact item IDs, material quantities, rarity, item-level scaling or disenchant skill. No measured casts.
affects: Newly created Crate of Battlefield Goods gear: acquisition character level 10-79 versus 80-90; TWW versus Midnight disenchant material family
wording: Newly created Crate of Battlefield Goods should now contain gear that disenchants into more relevant materials.
